model_annotation: The image displays three side-by-side pie charts illustrating the proportional distribution of subcategories within three primary classifications: "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive &Conjunctive." The third chart, titled "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," contains two nearly equal slices: Conjunctive in pale pink (50.49%) and Disjunctive in very pale blue (49.51%).
